subject: SDLC controls deep-dive and artifact ledger
messages:
From: Natalie Shaw <natalie.shaw@clearwater-assess.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDLC controls deep-dive request

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for making time this week. As part of our SIG/SOC2 deep-dive for Clearwater’s vendor assessment we need a granular mapping of Redwood’s secure SDLC controls. Specifically we are asking for:  

- A ledger (CSV or spreadsheet) that maps change requests/PRs to CI runs and deploys for the sample window (Jan 1, 2028 - Mar 31, 2028). Include commit SHAs, PR IDs, CI job IDs, artifact names, and the identity that approved the PR.
- Short excerpts of the CI runbook showing how ephemeral credentials are issued and rotated (redact any live secrets).
- A sample deploy log that shows keystore rotation or keystore handoff during a hotfix (timestamps + operator).

If you can provide the ledger and pointers to the CI logs by EOD Wednesday (4/4), that would keep us on schedule. Happy to take the files via a secure Drive link or uploaded to Clearwater’s intake portal.

Let me know if you need a narrower timebox/samples instead of full exports.

Best,
Natalie
Senior Assessor
Clearwater Assessments

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Shaw <natalie.shaw@clearwater-assess.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC controls deep-dive request

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear checklist. We can do that. Quick notes on scope so we align:  

- We'll provide a curated ledger covering representative PRs/CI runs/deploys for Feb–Mar 2028 (we'll include one hotfix from Jan as it contains the keystore rotation sample).
- Ledger will include commit SHA, PR id (GH), CI job id (internal), artifact name, approver (internal name), and a short note about the rollout policy used.
- CI runbook excerpt will be redacted and annotated (we'll mark any secrets with <REDACTED> and include the KMS/HSM references).

We'll upload to a restricted Drive folder and share a view-only link, plus attach a CSV snapshot to this thread. If that works, I'll follow up with the link and samples by EOD Wed.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:15:08 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC controls deep-dive request

Laura — quick ops checklist before we publish the ledger:  

1) For the approver column do we want human-readable names or SSO ids?
2) Which CI job IDs should we include — all jobs in the pipeline, or only the verification + artifact-publish steps?
3) I'll pull the deploy log for the hotfix, but it contains node-specific IPs; do we need to anonymize IPs or provide a mapping?

My recommendation: SSO-friendly ids (e.g., sso:marcus.lin) for audit linking; include verification + artifact-publish jobs only (keeps ledger concise); anonymize IPs but include anonymized node identifiers and a map in a separate sheet for the assessor if needed under NDA.

— Marcus
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Shaw <natalie.shaw@clearwater-assess.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 16:23:45 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC controls deep-dive request

Hi Natalie — attaching the ledger and two supporting artifacts as requested.  

Attachment stubs:  
- sdlc-artifact-ledger.csv (CSV): curated ledger; columns = date, commit_sha, pr_id, ci_job_id, artifact_name, approver_sso, rollout_policy, note
- ci-runbook-snippet.pdf (PDF): redacted excerpt that shows ephemeral credential issuance and the automated rotation trigger (comments added)
- deploy-keystore-rotation.log (txt): sanitized hotfix deployment log; IPs replaced with node-#### placeholders

Drive link (view-only, restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_sdlc-ledger (expires 2028-05-04)
HubSpot intake for this assessment: https://hubspot.com/contacts/CLR-8421 (reference id CLR-8421)

Notes on mapping: approver_sso values map to Redwood SSO identity; we included an internal mapping sheet in the Drive folder for assessors operating under our standard NDA. The CI job ids in the ledger correspond to the verification and artifact publish steps; we omitted non-blocking lint/ci tasks to keep the ledger focused on deploy-critical controls.

If you want raw CI traces for any specific job id for deeper sampling, Marcus can export them on a per-job basis; we prefer to avoid wholesale log dumps unless specifically requested.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Shaw <natalie.shaw@clearwater-assess.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@clearwater-assess.com
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC controls deep-dive request

Laura — received, and thanks for the fast turnaround. The ledger looks well-structured and the runbook snippet covers the ephemeral credential flow cleanly. A couple of follow-ups:  

- Can you add the SSO mapping sheet filename into the CSV (we couldn't find it in the Drive root)?
- We may request one raw CI trace for PR #2147 (verification job id 98321) — we'll raise that formally if needed.

If we need anything else I’ll flag it in HubSpot CLR-8421. Appreciate the clear notes and the sanitized log.

Best,
Natalie
Senior Assessor
Clearwater Assessments
